name: Jean-Luc Dubois
bio:
Jean-Luc's motorsport journey began in his youth, fueled by a passion for engineering and a fascination with Formula 1. He started as a data analyst for a small Belgian racing team, quickly proving his aptitude for strategy and race management. His meticulous approach and ability to anticipate track conditions led to several successful campaigns. Jean-Luc joined Walkenhorst Motorsport five years ago, bringing a wealth of experience in GT racing strategy. 

Known for his unwavering focus and commitment to precision, Jean-Luc is a demanding strategist who always pushes his team to excel. He believes in a data-driven approach, meticulously analyzing telemetry and weather patterns to gain a competitive edge. His colleagues appreciate his dedication but sometimes find his perfectionism challenging. Jean-Luc's ability to remain calm under pressure during crucial race moments sets him apart, earning him respect within the team and the wider motorsport community.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed back, receding hairline
physical.description: A man of average height with a serious demeanor, Jean-Luc has a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a worn copy of 'The Art of War'.
Insists on drinking Earl Grey tea during races.
Meticulously cleans his glasses every hour.
